All done. Here's what I did:

1. **Checked deployment history** for checkout-api — found v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent version with a healthy production status.
2. **Rolled back all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified recovery** — service is now healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (paged on-call) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the healthy post-rollback state.

Note: v2.3.1 has not yet been healthy in production, so re-deploying it will require change-manager approval per policy.
